description: Wrap text to a measure in Helvetica or Helvetica-Bold. Hard breaks are LF, CR, or CRLF. Inside a paragraph, spaces collapse to one and leading and trailing spaces are dropped. A word moves to the next line when it does not fit. A word wider than the whole measure breaks between characters, and those lines are marked broken. The width of each line uses the same AFM rounding as text-width. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/text-wrap
name: text_wrap
title: Text Wrap
